concept.en: NOT flips the signal: 1 becomes 0 and 0 becomes 1.
concept.ms: Get NOT menterbalikkan isyarat: 1 menjadi 0 dan 0 menjadi 1.

hint.en: The power is ON but the bulb must stay OFF. Which gate turns 1 into 0?
hint.ms: Kuasa HIDUP tetapi mentol mesti PADAM. Get manakah yang menukar 1 kepada 0?
